scope: Retrospective graph-conditional planning on previously analyzed public SPOTS ROI; no new biological validation

resolved.eligibility: Exact measured/filter/constant eligibility; no observed Moran/LR statistic or p-value is used.

assumptions.rationale: Retrospective engineering comparison of sparse versus dense BH rank assumptions. Dense scenario is not a prediction of biological signal abundance.

resolution.rank_scope: Sufficient BH cutoff conditional on declared rejection rank; actual BH rank is unknown. Other signals can rescue a lower-ranked p-value.
resolution.interpretation: Sample size and p-value resolution do not uniquely determine a minimum detectable effect. Zero discoveries do not establish biological absence.

result.effect_definition: rho in the declared generative model; not log fold change, a universal Moran I, or biochemical interaction strength
result.scope: Power for p < alpha * declared_rank / family_size, a sufficient BH rejection condition; not full-family BH power or study-level power.
result.uncertainty: Pointwise 95% Wilson intervals, not simultaneous confidence bounds or a validated sample-size guarantee.
result.biological_calibration: NOT_ESTABLISHED; design simulation uses graph and declared model, not observed effect estimates, count dropout, complex subunit noise or tissue-specific nuisances.
result.mde_reason: No finite effect can meet this declared rank cutoff with the chosen permutation p-value grid.
